say:1:1430216201:1.text: But my master has instructed me to invite this noble lady to his banquet.
say:1:1430216201:1.source_cn: 可是主人特意交代，让我一定邀请到贵族参加宴会。
say:1:1430216201:1.male: But my master has instructed me to invite this noble lady to his banquet.
say:1:1430216201:1.female: But my master has instructed me to invite this noble lady to his banquet.

say:2:1430216202:1.text: Should I fail, my lord will punish me severely...
say:2:1430216202:1.source_cn: 如果请不到贵族，主人一定会责罚我……
say:2:1430216202:1.male: Should I fail, my lord will punish me severely...
say:2:1430216202:1.female: Should I fail, my lord will punish me severely...

say:4:1430216203:1.text: See! Look at this lord's behavior! I will not attend!
say:4:1430216203:1.source_cn: 看看吧，这低劣的表现就是证明！我绝对不会参加！
say:4:1430216203:1.male: See! Look at this lord's behavior! I will not attend!
say:4:1430216203:1.female: See! Look at this lord's behavior! I will not attend!
